title: GE Vernova Q2 2026 earnings release
excerpt: Q2 orders were USD 24.2 billion, backlog was USD 176 billion, and free cash flow was USD 5.1 billion; 2026 free-cash-flow guidance rose to USD 11.5-12.5 billion.
summary: GE Vernova reported record Power and Electrification demand, margin expansion and cash generation, raised 2026 revenue and free-cash-flow guidance, and retained an approximately USD 400 million Wind EBITDA-loss outlook.
